content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-285. - Penalty.
content.summary:
Penalty for violation of any provision of this article shall be a fine of not less
               than $25.00 nor more than $500.00. Each day of a continuing violation shall be deemed
               to be a separate violation.
(Code 1981, § 21-80; Ord. No. 2451, § 1, 10-19-1987)
